The robot raises the carrot by its narrow tip; the thicker leafy end hangs downward as the carrot clears the tabletop. The gripper begins carrying it toward the plate on the right.
The arm carries the hanging carrot rightward and lowers it beside the plate. The carrot is positioned in front of and to the left of the plate, rather than centered over it.

The fingers open and release the carrot. It drops a short distance onto the tabletop outside the plate, with the green leaves facing the table front and the narrow tip near the plate left edge. The plate remains empty.
The open empty gripper pauses above the misplaced carrot. The carrot rests on the tabletop beside the empty plate without further manipulation.
The robot lifts and retracts its empty gripper. The carrot remains on the tabletop in front-left of the empty purple plate at the video end.
